title: 第一章 半夜钻他被窝
slug: 抢恶姐婚约随军被禁欲大佬亲哭
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

迷迷糊糊中，一双不算细嫩的手攀上沈时觐。

微凉的指尖轻轻摩挲着他的胸膛。

一点一点下移，在腰腹处顿住，打着转。

他想睁开眼，可饭桌上被林家夫妻灌了太多杯酒，眼皮沉得厉害。

他皱了皱眉，下意识把腰上的手拿开。

可没过一会儿功夫，那双手就又缠了上来。

随后，一股温热的气息喷在他脸上。

“我是梦里的女人，来渡你的。”

“你好好享受就行。”

淡淡的皂角香似有若无地往沈时觐鼻子里钻。

他头脑昏沉，一时理解不了她话里的意思。

只知道她的声音柔柔细细的，很好听。

混沌间，一片温热柔软覆上他的唇。

他的眉头皱得更深了。

他试图推开她。

可当指尖触到她的肩头时，却像是被烫到了一般，猛地缩回了手。

她的皮肤细腻又柔软，像是上好的绸缎。

这感觉很真实，不像是在做梦。

放在腰上的那双手很不安分，滑过他的腰线，往下走。

他心里顿时涌起一股酥酥麻麻的异样。

他的呼吸越来越急促，理智在一点点溃散。

很快，额角就渗出细密的汗珠，耳尖漫上一层薄红。

随后，那双手在那里顿住。

沈时觐猛地睁开眼，对上那双水汪汪的眼睛。

她眼波一晃，勾得他心里发慌。

“轰！！！”

心底最后那丝克制尽数褪去，只剩了浑身滚烫。

喉头滚了滚，他欺身而下。

一只手扣住她的细腰，低头咬住了她的唇。

昏旧的灯光投在两道交缠的身影上。

天快大亮的时候，沈时觐渐渐清醒过来。

短暂的呆愣，他迅速穿好裤子起身下床，冷着脸审视着躺在被窝里的女人，胸口剧烈起伏。

Page (1/3)

In a daze, a pair of not-so-delicate hands climbed up to Shen Shi's head.

Cool fingertips gently rubbed his chest.

Move down bit by bit, stop at the waist and abdomen, and rotate.

He wanted to open his eyes, but the Lin family drank too many glasses of wine at the dinner table, and his eyelids became extremely heavy.

He frowned and subconsciously took his hands away from his waist.

But after a while, the hands were entangled again.

Then, a warm breath sprayed on his face.

"I am the woman in the dream, here to save you."

"Just enjoy it."

The faint scent of soap locust penetrated Shen Shijin's nose.

His mind was so dizzy that he couldn't understand the meaning of her words.

All I know is that her voice is soft and thin, and it sounds nice.

In the chaos, a piece of warmth and softness covered his lips.

His frown deepened.

He tried to push her away.

But when his fingertips touched her shoulder, he suddenly retracted his hand as if he had been burned.

Her skin is delicate and soft, like fine silk.

It felt real, not like a dream.

The hands on his waist were very restless, sliding down his waistline and going down.

A strange tingling feeling suddenly surged in his heart.

His breathing became more and more rapid, and his sanity was crumbling little by little.

Soon, fine beads of sweat began to appear on his forehead, and the tips of his ears were covered with a thin layer of red.

Then, the hands paused there.

Shen Shijin opened his eyes suddenly and met those watery eyes.

Her eyes flickered, making him panic.

"Boom!!!"

The last trace of restraint in my heart faded away, leaving only a burning sensation all over my body.

His throat rolled, and he stepped down.

One hand clasped her slender waist, lowered his head and bit her lips.

The dim light cast on the two intertwined figures.

When it was almost dawn, Shen Shijin gradually woke up.

After a brief daze, he quickly put on his pants and got out of bed. He looked at the woman lying on the bed with a cold face, his chest rising and falling violently.
